Image Description: The image features a vintage-style suitcase placed upright against a dark brick wall, with the ground in front appearing to be concrete or asphalt. The suitcase is rectangular and has a light-colored, possibly off-white or cream, exterior with a slightly worn texture, suggesting age or frequent use. It has a rounded top handle and two small, visible legs at the bottom that elevate it slightly from the ground.

The central design on the suitcase is a stylized illustration of three women in elegant gowns
